sentences.en: He has always had a great curiosity about the world.
sentences.zh: 他一直对这个世界充满好奇。

sentences.en: Just out of curiosity, what do you expect to happen?
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，你预计会发生什么？

sentences.en: Just out of curiosity, what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，你要去做什么？

senses.zh: 好奇心, 爱打听的癖性 - 奇人, 奇物, 珍品
